name: skeleton-flexbox
description: The popular Skeleton CSS boilerplate with Flexbox-Grid and Normalize 8

scripts.build: npm run build:concat && npm run build:css && npm run build:prefix && npm run build:minify
scripts.build:concat: cat src/normalize.scss src/skeleton/base-styles.scss src/skeleton/typography.scss src/skeleton/buttons.scss src/skeleton/forms.scss src/skeleton/tables.scss src/skeleton/spacing.scss src/flexbox-grid.scss > dist/skeleton-flexbox.scss

author: Andre OBrien
